test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

He was able to do _____(tedious) jobs and hence decided to be in the airline service, which demanded 12 long hours of service.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tedious"** means something that is too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous. (नीरस)

 
 
• **Example:** The tedious task of sorting a huge stack of paperwork seemed never-ending.
 
 
 
• **"Delightful"** refers to something that is very pleasing, charming, or enjoyable. (आनंददायक)
 
 
• **Example:** The delightful weather made the picnic even more enjoyable.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'tedious' **is **'delightful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Irksome** (कष्टप्रद): Causing annoyance or irritation.

 
 
• **Example:** The constant noise from the construction site was irksome to the residents.
 
 
 
• **Riotous** (उन्मादी): Marked by or involving public disorder.
 
 
• **Example:** The riotous crowd was difficult for the police to control.
 
 
 
• **Timid** (डरपोक): Showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened.
 
 
• **Example:** The timid child hid behind his mother when strangers approached.
